# AutoWS GEMM knobs on B200: index

Every knob that changes generated code for an autoWS GEMM on B200 (mm, addmm, bmm and grouped GEMM, compiled with `TRITON_USE_META_WS=1`), with its feature file, how it is set, its legal values and default, its priority, where it applies and what it needs. Rows go P0 (highest), then P1, then P2 (lowest). The feature file has the knob's pruning rules and mechanism; the Doc column links the existing doc that explains the knob.

- Knobs that do not change generated code (IR dumps, plan-dump paths, verifier printouts) are not listed.
- ‡ marks an env var that changes generated code but is not in the compile cache key (`CACHE_INVALIDATING_ENV_VARS`, `include/triton/Tools/Sys/GetEnv.h`; `get_cache_key`, `python/triton/runtime/cache.py`): changing it does not invalidate cached kernels.
- Set via: `tl.range` kwargs are defined in `AutoWSLoopOptions` (`python/triton/language/core.py`); compile options in `CUDAOptions` (`third_party/nvidia/backend/compiler.py`); env vars in `nvidia_knobs` (`python/triton/knobs.py`); a "kernel pattern" is a way of writing the kernel, not a single setting.
- Prerequisite for every row: `TRITON_USE_META_WS=1` (in the cache key).

| Knob | Feature file | Set via | Legal values | Default | Priority | Applies when | Prereqs | Doc |

| `BLOCK_M` | [tiles_and_stages.md](tiles_and_stages.md) | kernel constexpr (M extent of the `tl.dot` tile) | power of 2, >= 64 | — | P0 | Every tcgen05 GEMM. A power of 2 below 64 gets no tcgen05 MMA and no gemm partition. | — | [tiles_and_stages.md, "Knobs"](tiles_and_stages.md#knobs); [resources.md, "TMEM"](resources.md#tmem) |
| `BLOCK_N` | [tiles_and_stages.md](tiles_and_stages.md) | kernel constexpr (N extent of the `tl.dot` tile) | power of 2, multiple of 8 | — | P0 | Every tcgen05 GEMM. Otherwise there is no tcgen05 MMA. | Under `two_ctas`, `BLOCK_N/2` >= 16. | [tiles_and_stages.md, "Knobs"](tiles_and_stages.md#knobs); [resources.md, "TMEM"](resources.md#tmem); [2cta.md, "Knobs"](2cta.md#knobs) |
| `BLOCK_K` | [tiles_and_stages.md](tiles_and_stages.md) | kernel constexpr (K step of the inner loop) | power of 2, >= 256 / operand bit width | — | P0 | Every tcgen05 GEMM. Below 256 / bit width (16 bf16, 32 fp8) there is no tcgen05 MMA. | — | [tiles_and_stages.md, "Knobs"](tiles_and_stages.md#knobs); [resources.md, "SMEM"](resources.md#smem) |

Below 1 is a compile error; above the depth that fits the SMEM budget no operand copies are added. | — | [tiles_and_stages.md, "Knobs"](tiles_and_stages.md#knobs); [SmemAllocationDesign.md, "Phase 4: Iterative Copy Increase"](../SmemAllocationDesign.md#phase-4-iterative-copy-increase) |
